messages.content: I'll trip to NY on December for 5 days. Can you make my plan?

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
Sure thing! To tailor a 5‑day NYC itinerary that feels just right for you, I’d love to know a bit more about your preferences:

| Question | Why it matters |
|----------|----------------|
| **What’s your main interest?** (e.g., art & museums, food & markets, nightlife, outdoor parks, shopping, theater) | Helps prioritize activities. |
| **Travel companions?** (solo, couple, family, kids, friends) | Determines suitable venues and pacing. |
| **Budget range** (accommodation, dining, tickets) | Guides hotel and activity choices. |
| **Accommodation preference** (hotel, Airbnb, hostels, boutique) | Influences location recommendations. |
| **Dining preferences** (vegetarian, vegan, gluten‑free, foodie, casual) | Suggests restaurants and food tours. |
| **Transportation** (public transit only, rideshare, car rental) | Affects daily planning and timing. |
| **Any must‑see or must‑do items** (e.g., Broadway show, Central Park bike ride, rooftop bar) | Ensures they’re included. |

If you’d like, I can also pull up the current weather forecast for New York City so you can pack accordingly. Just let me know which of the above details you’d like to share, or feel free to give me a quick snapshot of your travel style and any “must‑have” experiences!
